title: 便箋・メッセージカードの枠
subject_en: Letter paper and message card borders in clean line-and-colour style with an EMPTY centre filled with plain white so it becomes transparent; each frame is ONE separate piece centred in its cell, thick enough to hold text or a photo. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: お礼・お祝い・お見舞い・季節のあいさつなど、手紙やメッセージカード向けの枠12点です。中央をあけてあるので、文字を重ねて使えます。
